```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(rsample)
library(randomForest)
library(nnet)
```


```{r}
log_reg_model <- multinom_reg(mode = "classification") %>%
  set_engine("nnet")
```

```{r}
rand_forest_model <- rand_forest(mode = "classification") %>%
  set_engine("randomForest")
```

```{r}
penguin_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 10)
```

```{r}
wf_obj <- workflow_set(
  preproc = list(recipe(species ~ ., data = train_data)),
  models = list(log_reg = log_reg_model, rf = rand_forest_model),
  cross = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
wf_obj <- wf_obj %>%
  workflow_map("fit_resamples", resamples = penguin_folds)
```

```{r}
metrics_results <- wf_obj %>%
  collect_metrics() %>%
  filter(.metric == "accuracy")
```

```{r}
metrics_results
```


```{r}
# Ensure missing values are handled
train_data_clean <- na.omit(train_data)
test_data_clean <- na.omit(test_data)

# Recreate the folds with the cleaned training data
penguin_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data_clean, v = 10)

# Define the models again
log_reg_model <- multinom_reg(mode = "classification") %>%
  set_engine("nnet")

rand_forest_model <- rand_forest(mode = "classification") %>%
  set_engine("randomForest")

# Create the workflow set with the cleaned data
wf_obj <- workflow_set(
  preproc = list(recipe(species ~ ., data = train_data_clean)),
  models = list(log_reg = log_reg_model, rf = rand_forest_model),
  cross = TRUE
)

# Fit the models using cross-validation
wf_obj <- wf_obj %>%
  workflow_map("fit_resamples", resamples = penguin_folds)

# Collect the accuracy metrics
metrics_results <- wf_obj %>%
  collect_metrics() %>%
  filter(.metric == "accuracy")

# View the results
metrics_results

```
